title.en: Endangered Species (Import and Export) (Display of Elephant Ivory — Exemption) Order 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Endangered Species (Import and Export) (Display of Elephant Ivory — Exemption) Order 2021.

2. In this Order, “elephant ivory” means any tusk or tooth from a specimen of Elephas maximus (Asian elephant) or Loxodonta africana (African elephant), whether worked, unworked or prepared, or any part, powder or waste of that tusk or tooth.
3. Section 4(1)(c) of the Act does not apply to the display of any elephant ivory to the public for educational or religious purposes.
